speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, could you please tell me how many weeks pregnant you are and when your fever and headache first started?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you notice any changes in your baby's movement, and have you experienced any abdominal pain or vaginal bleeding? I also need to know if you consumed any unpasteurized dairy products recently, as this history is concerning for Listeriosis.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify if the ice cream you consumed was from a known brand or potentially homemade, and whether you have noticed any flu-like muscle aches or gastrointestinal symptoms like nausea or diarrhea. REQUEST TEST: Blood_Culture

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Blood_Cultures: Gram-positive rods that are catalase-positive and show distinctive tumbling motility in the liquid medium.

speaker: Doctor
text: The blood culture results showing Gram-positive rods with tumbling motility are classic for *Listeria monocytogenes*, confirming the suspicion of Listeriosis. I will now proceed to initiate treatment to protect both you and the fetus. DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis
